```yaml
name: Test / Scheduled

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 02:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  push:
    branches:
      - 'master'
      - 'release/*'

jobs:
  test-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php: ['8.2', '8.3', '8.4']
        db: ['mariadb:11.8', 'mysql:8.4']
        include:
          # Full matrix for release branches
          - php: '8.2'
            db: 'mariadb:11.8'
            coverage: true
          - php: '8.3'
            db: 'mariadb:11.8'
            coverage: true
          - php: '8.4'
            db: 'mysql:8.4'
            coverage: true
          - php: '8.2'
            db: 'mysql:8.4'
            coverage: true
          - php: '8.3'
            db: 'mysql:8.4'
            coverage: true
          - php: '8.4'
            db: 'mariadb:11.8'
            coverage: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          coverage: ${{ matrix.coverage && 'pcov' || 'none' }}
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Wait for database
        run: |
          until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p"${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}" --silent; do
            echo "Waiting for database..."
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --coverage-clover=coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: ./coverage.xml
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  phpstan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run PHPStan
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration phpstan.neon --level=7 src/

  rector:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run Rector
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/rector process --config rector.php --dry-run

  styling-php:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run PHP-CS-Fixer
        run: |
          ./vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff

  styling-js:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: |
          npm run lint:js

  styling-css:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Stylelint
        run: |
          npm run lint:css

  syntax:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql, mysqli, curl, zip, gd, soap, xml, openssl, bcmath, pcntl, posix
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Run PHP Syntax Check
        run: |
          find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | xargs -P 4 -I {} php -l {}

  js-unit-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run JavaScript Unit Tests
        run: |
          npm run test:unit

  sql-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install SQLLint
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y sqruff

      - name: Run SQL Lint
        run: |
          find . -name "*.sql" | xargs sqruff lint

  semgrep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Semgrep
        uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: p/php p/javascript p/python
          publishToken: ${{ secrets.SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN }}
```
